query:
WITH picked AS (
                SELECT id
                FROM realtime_outbox
                WHERE status = 'pending'
                  AND next_retry_at <= NOW()
                ORDER BY created_at, id
                LIMIT $1
                FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            )
            UPDATE realtime_outbox o
            SET status = 'processing',
                locked_by = $2,
                locked_at = NOW()
            FROM picked
            WHERE o.id = picked.id
            RETURNING
                o.id,
                o.aggregate_type,
                o.aggregate_id,
                o.event_type,
                o.event_version,
                o.aggregate_version,
                o.payload,
                o.status,
                o.attempts,
                o.next_retry_at,
                o.locked_by,
                o.locked_at,
                o.created_at,
                o.dispatched_at,
                o.last_error
